note: Lobby castle banner on a pole.

note: Skeleton id. Upright armoured beetle soldier with blade arms.

note: Bomber id. Tick with a glowing, swelling abdomen that explodes.

note: XP crystal (scaled and recoloured per gem size).

note: Armoured warrior: plumed helm, red cape, shield, glowing sword.

note: Slime id. Small scuttling alien mite.

note: Ghost id. Glowing moth that drifts through the swarm.

note: Healer priest: white and gold robes, halo, sun staff.

note: Brute id. Huge armoured beetle with a battering horn.

note: Shadow rogue: deep purple hood, mask, twin glowing daggers.

note: Boss. Giant armoured scorpion with glowing seams, claws and a stinger tail.

note: Wall/standing torch for the lobby and ruins.
